{{Quote|No&hellip;your name is ''Vydel Dir'Nul''&hellip;I&hellip;I've been tracking you for six months&hellip;finally&hellip;caught up to you&hellip;|The male Jedi, to Vydel Dir'Nul|<ref name="Dark Journey" />}}
A [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] '''Jedi''' served the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi Council]] dispatched the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] to track down and apprehend the female [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Vydel Dir'Nul]]. After six [[Time/Legends|months]] of searching, the Jedi found and confronted Dir'Nul on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Perilious]]. After defeating her in a [[Lightsaber duel/Legends|duel]], she attacked him with [[Force lightning/Legends|Force lightning]] and reverted to the personality of the male [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] Kardem, which she had created after [[Death/Legends|murdering]] her lover [[Ash B'risko]]. The Jedi attempted to kill Dir'Nul, but he was instead slain by the Jedi Knight.

==Biography==
{{Quote|I've seen it before,&hellip;the Jedi are forbidden to know love for ''many'' reasons&hellip;and you will be brought back for the Council&hellip;''dead or alive!''|The Jedi, as he attempts to kill Vydel Dir'Nul|<ref name="Dark Journey" />}}
[[File:Vydel.jpg|thumb|left|150px|Vydel Dir'nul, whom the Jedi was sent to apprehend.]]
A [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] was a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] who served the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], a [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] conflict between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi Council]] sent him to track down and apprehend the former [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Vydel Dir'Nul]]. He confronted Dir'Nul, who assumed that he was the [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] Kardem, on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Perilious]]. After the Jedi bested her in a [[Lightsaber duel/Legends|lightsaber duel]], Dir'Nul reverted to the Kardem personality&mdash;whom she had created after [[Death/Legends|killing]] her lover, [[Ash B'risko]]&mdash;and tortured the Jedi with [[Force lightning/Legends|Force lightning]]. After he explained why the Council had sent him after her, the Jedi attempted to kill her, but was ultimately defeated and killed by Dir'Nul. Shortly after his death, Dir'Nul&mdash;who reverted back to her original personality&mdash;vowed to stop Kardem, unaware that she was the person that had killed the male Jedi.<ref name="Dark Journey" />

==Personality and traits==
The Jedi was determined to apprehend Vydel Dir'Nul and return her to the Jedi Council, regardless of whether she was living or deceased. He used a [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] containing a [[Color/Legends|green]] [[Lightsaber crystal/Legends|crystal]].<ref name="Dark Journey" />

==Powers and abilities==
The Jedi was able to defeat Vydel Dir'Nul in [[Lightsaber combat/Legends|lightsaber combat]]. He also displayed his ability to use the Force to [[Telekinesis/Legends|throw]] his [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] at Dir'Nul.<ref name="Dark Journey" />

==Behind the scenes==
The male Jedi first appeared in the short [[Star Wars comic books|comic]] "[[Dark Journey (comic story)|Dark Journey]]," which was featured in [[Star Wars Tales 17|''Star Wars Tales'' 17]] and written by [[Jason Hall]]. In the comic, he was drawn by [[Ben Templesmith]]. The story was later compiled into a trade paperback version and republished in ''[[Star Wars Tales Volume 5]]''. Plausible stories in [[Star Wars Tales 1|''Star Wars Tales'' 1]]&ndash;''[[Star Wars Tales 20|20]]'' were initially viewed as [[Canon|S-canon]] until referenced in a non-''Tales'' source, at which point the subject matter was elevated to C-canon status.<ref>{{SWBoards|url=thread.jspa?threadID=152583&start=752#14952461|thread=Holocron continuity database questions|user=[[Leland Chee|Leland Y Chee]]|date=2006-06-04|time=3:05 AM}}</ref> Because Vydel Dir'Nul received references outside of the ''Tales'' comic,<ref name="The History of the Mandalorians">{{InsiderCite|80|The History of the Mandalorians: Exploring the Evolution of a Mighty Race of Warriors}}</ref><ref name="The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia">{{CSWECite|I|190|Dir'Nul, Vydel}}</ref> the events of ''Dark Journey'' were elevated to C-canon, thus establishing the Jedi who was slain by Dir'Nul as a canonical character.
